$documentation: Machine-readable index of Rust engine panic families. Authoritative prose lives in engine-gaps.md; this file exists so digimon-training-mcp can group panics in training console logs by family. Each entry's `pattern` is a Python re.compile-compatible regex matched against the panic message text (the part after `<ExcType>: ` in the [recorder env=... ENGINE PANIC #N: ...] log line). Add new entries here when engine-gaps.md gains a new family; CI smoke (planned) cross-checks consistency.

families.description: DSL outer-tail park assertion overwritten — a nested park collided with an existing parked tail. See engine-gaps.md §Nested DSL Outer-Tail Park.
play_option_core invoked while another Option is mid-resolution. Resolved via pending_end_turn_resume in PR #520. See engine-gaps.md §Reentrant Option Play.

Two simultaneous deletions both attempting to install pending_deletion_resume (single-outstanding-invariant slot). Resolved 2026-05-23 by PR #525 (DCGO-modeled batched deletion). See engine-gaps.md §Nested Deferred Deletion.

Permanent::top_card() called on a Permanent whose card_sources Vec was emptied by a `Material(carrier, i)` extraction in `effect_initiated_digivolve_from_source_inner`. Resolved 2026-05-23 by PR #533 (introduced `Game::soft_remove_if_emptied`). The original `G-PERMANENT-EMPTY-DURING-BATCH-DELETION` family ID was a misnomer (the cause was material extraction, not batch deletion); renamed in the 2026-05-24 family split. See engine-gaps.md §Empty Permanent During Batched Deletion — digivolve-from-material zombie.
